terrain_quad_tree.description: Terrain is a quad-tree of CTerrainNode. Root = whole terrain, leaves = individual sectors.

e_TerrainLodErrorRatio.effect: Max allowed pixel error at LOD transition. Lower = finer mesh near camera. Fixes LOD-seam z-fighting.

e_TerrainLodDistanceRatio.effect: Radius multiplier for fine LOD. Higher = fine mesh at larger distance from camera.

e_WaterOceanBottom.effect: 0 disables ocean bottom fill quad. Often the primary z-fighting cause.

e_TerrainAutoGenerateBaseTexture.effect: 1 = generate base texture at runtime from painted terrain materials. Requires valid cover.ctc to init pool first.

z_fighting_causes.fix: e_WaterOcean 0 + e_WaterOceanBottom 0, or move OceanWaterLevel to -100

z_fighting_causes.symptom: Flickering patches at terrain sector boundaries
Floor at mid-screen, flickering black (backface) and texture
z_fighting_causes.fix: Increase camera eye height above entity origin (1.8 m fallback when no character)

z_fighting_causes.symptom: Solid black walkable squares on terrain (not z-fighting, but rendering nothing)
